body.title: Common floor is held by every member, not approved members
body.body:
## What changed
- **README:** "above the common floor every approved member has" becomes "above the common floor every member has".

## Why
Membership needs no approval: anyone becomes a member by being a person and creating their UID. The common floor belongs to every member (see draykerdk/distributed-support).

body.title: Describe Dk Personal's outward representation
body.body:
README gains a paragraph after curation: beyond the anonymous background
exchange and as far as the person authorizes, Dk Personal promotes their
interests with material arguments only, and the maturity of the personal
Dknowledge weighs more than computation in its precision. The component
contract gains the matching scope item.

Founder decision (07/10/2026):
"O Dk pessoal não tem nada a vender ou consenso a fabricar, mas ele vende seus interesses e ideias, sua representação, não vendendo literalmente, mas te representando no contexto global de decisões e gerenciamento dos recursos e construção de prioridades do sistema."
"não é uma venda em si, ele não pode mentir, deve ser sincero e o argumento deve ser baseado na materialidade, nos dados… é uma influência"
"É importante a questão da maturidade dos Dknowledges pessoais e de projetos, ela vai influenciar mais na inteligência e precisão do seu Dk… mais do que a própria computação."

body.title: Recommendations and encounters; a member council instead of the judicial panel
body.body_html:
Aligns this repository with the decisions of October 2026:

  • member councils formed for each question instead of an independent judicial panel chosen by lot;
  • no forks or open-code claims for Dk: auditable through Dknowledge and DFM by permission level, with divergence tested in parallel;
  • Dk Global decides only inside the space the constitution gives it, open to representation, proposals and justified vetoes;
  • units of account instead of a token economy.

body.title: Justified vetoes with grounds; single-veto adjustment after triage
body.body:
Alignment pass across the `draykerdk` organization, on the branch `alinhamento/2026-09` in every affected repository.

## Changes

- docs: situated vetoes are signed and recorded in the veto chain
- docs: a single well-founded veto can lead to adjustment after triage

## Across the organization

- Governance corrected: PAP is Projects & Applications, DFMP is the DFM proposal process, the founding account is `Hyadhuad`, and the governance horizon runs from the founding Embassy through the DAF into PAP.
- The veto chain specified in UID: signed, hash-linked vetoes that carry their real grounds even when anonymous; vetoes weighed by grounds, not counted; one veto with grounds beyond the decision's scope can lead to an adjustment after advanced triage.
- Direction states 2033 as the objective, measured by what works rather than by the date.
- Intelligence is a partner, never the master.
- English is the canonical documentation language.
- Documentation states its own claims and does not cite outside books as authority.

Documentation only. Nothing here claims an implemented system.

Supersedes #4, closed when the branch was renamed.

body.title: Write one concrete personal use case
body.body:
## What is delivered
One concrete personal use case, written out: who it is for, what actually hurts for them today, which data the agent would be allowed to touch, what result it produces, and how you would judge whether it worked.

One person, one situation. Not a feature list.

## Why it is needed
Dk Personal is the thinnest component in the ecosystem, and unlike the others there is no unpublished specification waiting to be released — internally it exists as an index note and an admitted interpretation. Nothing about what the agent may keep, send upward or refuse can be settled while the thing it is supposed to do stays abstract.

This function is first on purpose. Everything else in this repository waits on it.

## Where to start
Pick a situation you actually recognise. An assistant designed from a persona tends to produce guarantees nobody needed.

The one constraint that is not negotiable: no real personal data, anywhere in the example.

---
This is an open function: small enough for one person to finish, defined enough that the result composes with the rest. Claim it in this thread before starting so two people do not carry the same function, and deliver through a pull request to `master`. It appears on the board at https://drayker.org/fn/
